title: 正一皈依法会
body: 2026年1月11日，美国阳翥道教协会举行正一皈依法会，依循正统科仪，宣戒授号，上表奏告，仪式庄严肃穆，圆满完成。皈依，是信士正式归入道门的重要仪式，象征确立信仰方向，开启修行之路。通过传统仪轨，参与者在天地神明之前立志向道，成为道教正式皈依居士。本次法会吸引了来自不同国家与文化背景的参与者，不仅有华人信众，也有来自美国、澳大利亚等地的人士正式皈依道教。这显示出道教文化在当代国际社会中的持续传播与广泛吸引力，体现了传统宗教在跨文化语境中的生命力与实践价值。美国阳翥道教协会将继续秉持正统传承与规范发展的原则，推动道教文化在国际社会中的稳步发展与深入交流。
body_en: On January 11, 2026, the Yangzhu Taoist Association of America held a Zhengyi Taoist Initiation Ceremony, following orthodox ritual protocols including the proclamation of precepts, bestowing of Taoist names, and the submission of ceremonial memorials to the heavens. The ceremony was conducted with solemnity and reverence, reaching a successful completion. The initiation ceremony is an important rite marking the formal entry of devotees into the Taoist faith, symbolizing the establishment of their spiritual direction and the beginning of their cultivation path. Through traditional rituals, participants made their vows before heaven, earth, and the divine spirits, becoming officially initiated Taoist laypeople. This ceremony attracted participants from diverse national and cultural backgrounds, including not only Chinese devotees but also individuals from the United States, Australia, and other countries who formally converted to Taoism. This demonstrates the continued spread and broad appeal of Taoist culture in contemporary international society, reflecting the vitality and practical value of traditional religion in cross-cultural contexts. The Yangzhu Taoist Association of America will continue to uphold the principles of orthodox transmission and standardized development, promoting the steady growth and deeper exchange of Taoist culture in the international community.
